relations.subject: Lopön Tenzin Namdak
relations.evidence: During 1945–50, he lived a principally eremitic existence, cloistered with his tutor and guru Gangru Tsültrim Gyeltsen (Wylie: sgang ru tshul khrims rgyal mtshan), with whom he studied poetry

relations.subject: Lopön Tenzin Namdak
relations.evidence: In 1950, Tenzin Namdak went to Menri Monasteryin Tsang. On the instruction of his teacher, he commenced his studies. In 1953, he was elected to the position of lopön (head teacher) and received the degree of geshe.

relations.subject: Lopön Tenzin Namdak
relations.evidence: In 1953, he was elected to the position of lopön (head teacher) and received the degree of geshe. ... Tenzin Namdak left Menri in 1959

relations.subject: Lopön Tenzin Namdak
relations.evidence: While in Kathmandu in 1961, Tenzin Namdak was invited to London by his colleague, the English tibetologist David Snellgrove, through a Rockefeller Foundation grant, where he became a visiting scholar at SOAS

relations.subject: Lopön Tenzin Namdak
relations.evidence: The collaboration with Snellgrove resulted in the publication of The Nine Ways of Bon

relations.subject: Lopön Tenzin Namdak
relations.evidence: In 1969, Tenzin Namdak made a second visit to Europe at the invitation of Professor Helmut Hoffmann, where he was a visiting scholar at LMU Munich

relations.subject: Lopön Tenzin Namdak
relations.evidence: at the invitation of Professor Helmut Hoffmann, where he was a visiting scholar at LMU Munich, and with whom he collaborated on the Dictionary of Written Tibetan.

relations.subject: Lopön Tenzin Namdak
relations.evidence: From 1967, when the first monks came to Dolanji, teaching had been done by Lopön Sangye Tenzin, the former head teaching master at Menri, and assisted by Tenzin Namdak, who became his successor.

relations.subject: Lopön Tenzin Namdak
relations.evidence: Thus a lama's college (shedrup; bshad sgrub) was established in 1978, organized under the guidance of Lopön Rinpoche who served as one of the two professors. The official name of the college is Yungdrung Bön Shedrup Lobnyer Dude
